name: Shallum
overview: Shallum was a male figure noted in Scripture for his role in the physical restoration of Jerusalem. He and his daughters participated in repairing the wall of Jerusalem, demonstrating a commitment to the community's safety and spiritual heritage. No tribal affiliation or additional personal notes are recorded for him.
namesAndTitles: The name Shallum means 'peace, well-being, prosperity,' reflecting a positive and hopeful significance. This proper name was not given directly by God but carries meaningful connotations within the biblical context.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records that Shallum was the father of Hallohesh. Beyond this, no other family relationships are detailed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shallum's significance lies primarily in his active contribution to the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, an important task that symbolized the restoration of God's people after exile. His involvement alongside his daughters highlights the communal effort in reestablishing the city's defenses and spiritual identity. This work underlines the faithful obedience and dedication required to uphold God's covenant community.
